ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio of low-intensity black pixels (~90-95%) to high-intensity white/yellowish pixels (~5-10%) across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark contiguous field with distinct high-contrast linear streaks appearing at various angles on the left lobe and small circular pixel clusters distributed throughout.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep central V-shaped notch with a sharp vertex; the angle of convergence is approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the continuous boundary with variable pixel-amplitude peaks, particularly dense in the regions flanking the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the trailing edge, tapering to elongated, slightly upturned terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, circular high-contrast pixel clusters scattered primarily on the mid-to-lower sections of the left and central fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white and yellowish linear pixel disruptions (scratches) of varying lengths and orientations across both lobes, most prominent on the left.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring across the ventral surface and significantly irregular, textured distal tips showing high-contrast pixel clusters and structural distortion.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized yellowish pixel pigmentation within several of the deeper linear abrasions near the central fluke region.
